title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-24 02:42:16 最新章节：第九十九章突然变强的神识
content_zh:
“秦风，你不过是我们龙家养的一条狗罢了，居然也想着进入化龙池？你以为你体内流淌着是我们龙家的血脉吗？”
“真是不知廉耻，摆不清自己的地位？”
东土大陆，龙城，龙家内府里。
一位年龄不过十六岁的妙龄少女，正用极其不屑的目光以及带着侮辱性的口吻，盯着眼前正紧咬牙关，双拳紧握的少年道。
少年刚满十六岁，乃是龙家家主的养子，名为秦风。
之所以不是龙姓，那是因为龙家族规中说过，无论是谁，收养子女，只要体内没有龙家血脉者，皆不可以龙为姓。
这便是龙家的威严所在！！
而秦风正是没有龙家血脉的养子，自然也就没有龙姓资格。
“妹妹，和这家伙说这么多干嘛？他一个外姓人，平事在我们龙家不愁吃喝，又有修炼资源，还能在龙城里受人尊重，时间久了，或许他真没把自己当外人了。”
“秦风，看来你的确拎不清楚，家养的狗和野外的狗，有什么区别吧？”
这时，又一位站在少女身边的少年说道。
闻言二人的话，秦风强忍心中怒火道：“龙云飞，龙云沁，难道这么多年，我秦风在你们二人心里就是狗？难道你们忘了这些年来，我秦风为你们兄妹背了多少锅？”
“上次你们将天城叶家一位长老的孙子玩死，人家找上门来，要家族赔偿一大笔灵石，还有你们兄妹二人的一只手。”
“结果呢？是我被你们踢出去背锅，差点被叶家长老活生生打死在龙城里。”
“要不是龙野爷爷出手相助，我现在已经是死人了！！”
“等等，你说错了。”
“不是死人，而是死狗！”
“哈哈哈！！”
就在秦风话落之时，龙家少主龙云飞戏谑接话道。
他身边的龙云沁也跟着捂嘴笑出了声。

龙家内府里，一群家族高层，也都各有神情，但却没人出声帮秦风说话。
只有坐在族长位置上的龙战，微微蹙眉，目光落在秦风身上，也没有说什么。
毕竟，龙云飞和龙云沁可是他龙战的种，更是龙家有史以来所生出来的第一对龙凤胎。
二人天赋极佳，在修炼一途，如鱼得水，不满十六岁，就已经修炼到了通天境......
放在别的家族势力里，肯定是最妖孽的天才，没有之一。
可在这对兄妹二人之上，还有一位龙家妖孽，在十四岁时就踏入了通天境，打破了龙城乃至整个东土大陆最快修炼到通天境的记录。
而这个人，便是龙战养子，秦风！！
身为龙家养子，却成为了龙城最妖孽的天才，这不仅没有往龙战脸上贴金，反而成为了龙家众多年轻一辈心中的耻辱。
特别是兄妹二人，仗着自己的身份地位，百般刁难秦风。
什么脏事，烂事，都往秦风身上丢，让后者这一年多来，不知道吃了多少苦头，受了多少委屈，吞了多少苦果！！！
即便如此，秦风都没有说什么，更没有找养父龙战抱怨半句，整个龙家，除了将秦风带大的龙野以外，没有人替他在龙战面前以及龙家其余高层面前，说过半句好话。
更没有人会觉得，龙云飞和龙云沁的做法有问题。
在这些龙家人的心里，龙家圣子圣女的天赋，居然不如家养的狗，这简直就是对龙家莫大的羞辱。
哪怕秦风这些年来，为了龙家做了不少事情，且十分本分，从不惹事，还主动抗事，但那又如何？
毕竟，这龙城可是姓龙，而不是姓秦啊。
听到龙云飞再次嘲讽自己的话后，秦风继续强忍怒火，甚至还努力让自己变得平静。
他缓缓抬头，目光看向四周。
从龙家每一位高层身上扫过，也包括自己这位养父，龙战。
可秦风并没有从这些家族高层眼里，看出了任何一点对自己在意的目光。
即便是龙战也眼神飘忽，没有了曾经需要自己时候的那种信任和鼓励。

直到兄妹二人的笑声消失后，秦风终于笑出声道：“好好好，想不到我秦风无论为家族付出再多，也不过是你们心里的一条狗。”
“恐怕我连家族那些奴隶的性命都不如吧？”
“也对，毕竟我只是养子，体内没有流淌着高贵的龙家血脉。”
“可笑，太可笑了。”
话音落下，一位龙家高层怒喝道：“秦风，放肆！”
content_en:
"Qin Feng, you are just a dog raised by our Long family, and you actually want to enter the Dragon Transformation Pond? Do you think you have the blood of our Long family flowing in your body?"
"You are really shameless and can't understand your status?"
Dongtu Continent, Dragon City, the inner palace of the Long Family.
A young girl who was only sixteen years old was staring at the young man in front of her who was clenching her teeth and clenching her fists with extremely disdainful eyes and an insulting tone.
The young man has just turned sixteen and is the adopted son of the head of the Long family, named Qin Feng.
The reason why the surname is not Long is because it is stated in the Long family rules that no matter who adopts a child, as long as they do not have the blood of the Long family in their body, they cannot have the surname Long.
This is the majesty of the Long family! !
And Qin Feng is an adopted son who does not have the blood of the Long family, so naturally he is not qualified to be named Long.
"Sister, why are you talking to this guy so much? He has a foreign surname. He has no worries about food and drink in our Long family. He also has training resources and is respected by people in Long City. As time goes by, maybe he really doesn't regard himself as an outsider."
"Qin Feng, it seems that you really can't understand clearly. What's the difference between domestic dogs and dogs in the wild?"
At this time, another boy standing next to the girl said.
Hearing what they said, Qin Feng suppressed the anger in his heart and said: "Long Yunfei, Long Yunqin, is it possible that for so many years, I, Qin Feng, have been a dog in the hearts of you two? Have you forgotten how much blame I, Qin Feng, have taken for your brothers and sisters over the years?"
"Last time you played to death the grandson of an elder of the Ye family in Tiancheng. He came to your door and demanded that the family pay a large amount of spiritual stones and one of your brother and sister's hands."
"What's the result? I was kicked out by you and took the blame, and I was almost beaten to death in Dragon City by Elder Ye."
"If Grandpa Tatsuno hadn't helped me, I would be dead now!!"
"Wait, you said it wrong."
"It's not a dead man, it's a dead dog!"
"Hahaha!!"
Just when Qin Feng finished speaking, Long Yunfei, the young master of the Long family, joked.
Long Yunqin beside him also covered his mouth and laughed.
In the Long family's inner palace, a group of senior family members all had their own expressions, but no one spoke up to help Qin Feng.
Only Long Zhan, who was sitting in the position of the clan leader, frowned slightly and looked at Qin Feng without saying anything.
After all, Long Yunfei and Long Yunqin were his Long Zhan's offspring, and they were the first pair of dragon and phoenix twins ever born in the Long family.
The two of them are extremely talented. They are like a fish in water during their cultivation. Under the age of sixteen, they have already reached the realm of Tongtian...
Among other family forces, he must be the most evil genius, bar none.
But above these two brothers and sisters, there is another evildoer from the Long family who entered the Tongtian realm at the age of fourteen, breaking the record of the fastest person to reach the Tongtian realm in Dragon City and even the entire East Earth Continent.
And this person is Long Zhan’s adopted son, Qin Feng! !
As the adopted son of the Long family, he became the most evil genius in Long City. Not only did this not flatter Long Zhan's face, but it became a shame in the hearts of many younger generations of the Long family.
Especially the brother and sister, relying on their status, made things difficult for Qin Feng in every possible way.
Everything dirty and bad was thrown at Qin Feng, who has suffered so much, suffered so many grievances, and swallowed so many bitter fruits over the past year! ! !
Even so, Qin Feng didn't say anything, let alone complain to his adoptive father Long Zhan. In the entire Long family, except Long Ye, who brought Qin Feng up, no one said a good word for him in front of Long Zhan and other senior officials of the Long family.
No one would think that there was anything wrong with what Long Yunfei and Long Yunqin did.
In the hearts of these Long family members, the talents of the holy sons and daughters of the Long family are actually not as good as the domestic dogs. This is simply a great humiliation to the Long family.
Even though Qin Feng has done a lot for the Long family over the years, and he is very responsible, never causing trouble, and even taking the initiative to fight against it,But so what?
After all, this Dragon City's surname is Long, not Qin.
After hearing Long Yunfei mocking him again, Qin Feng continued to hold back his anger and even tried to calm himself down.
He slowly raised his head and looked around.
He scanned every senior member of the Long family, including his adoptive father, Long Zhan.
But Qin Feng didn't see any concern for him in the eyes of these family senior officials.
Even Long Zhan's eyes were wandering, without the trust and encouragement he once had when he needed him.
After the laughter of the two brothers and sisters disappeared, Qin Feng finally laughed and said: "Okay, okay, I never thought that no matter how much I, Qin Feng, do for the family, I am just a dog in your heart."
"I'm afraid I'm not as good as the lives of the slaves in my family, right?"
"That's right. After all, I'm just an adopted son, and I don't have the noble Long family blood flowing in my body."
"It's ridiculous, it's ridiculous."
After the words fell, a senior member of the Long family shouted angrily: "Qin Feng, you are so presumptuous!"
